paragraphs: Rav Mesharshiya son of Rav Dimi. Mentioned in [Gittin 78a](https://www.sefaria.org/Gittin.78a.8).[^1][^2]

notes.text: The linked passage gives Rav Mesharshiya bar Rav Dimi’s explanation of the case involving a basket seller.
[Heilprin’s short notice](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2575&lang=en) cites the same folio and names Rav Dimi as his father.
